newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH JAN-JULY BUILDING PERMITS RISE - SF.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH JAN-JULY BUILDING PERMITS RISE - SF.

text.p: The construction volume for which building permits were granted rose 25 percent year-on-year in January-July to 18.4 million cubic metres, Statistics Finland said in a statement on Friday.

Building permits for housing construction rose 14 percent year-on-year in January-July to five million cubic metres, and building permits for industrial constructions rose 25 percent to almost four million cubic metres, it said.
In July, building permits were granted for 1.5 million cubic metres.
